name: Konparu Takayuki
source:
"You're a nuisance. If you have no business here, leave."

[Class] First Year Fujigumi (Wisteria)
[Personality] Serious, Stubborn, Hot-blooded
[Specialty] Brazilian Jiu-Jitsu

He is the strongest between all the first-years and part of the class next to the [url=/c39873]heroine's[/url]. As a user of jiu-jitsu he fights regardless of his physique. In regard to the heroine, who is smaller than everyone else, he feels a kindred spirit and is kind to her somewhat. But, because he dislikes women under the prejudice that "women = weak", never in his wildest dreams would he think that the heroine is a girl.

[Translation taken from [url=http://otome-jikan.net/2015/11/14/kenka-banchou-otome/]Otome Jikan[/url]]
